Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

She has long hair · He's tall
FormUseExample
be + adjtall / friendlyShe's tall. He's young.
has / havehair, eyesShe has long hair.
's got= has gotShe's got brown eyes.
ordersize + age + coloura tall young man
  • Describe with to be + adjective: He's tall. She's friendly. (not 'He has tall')
  • Use has/have for hair & eyes: She has long hair. I have brown eyes.
  • 's got = has got: She's got blue eyes. (same meaning)
  • Adjective order: size + age + colour + noun → a tall young man, a big old house.

→ Hobbies with like + -ing (I like dancing) come next.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: She + long hair → She HAS long hair. Order: a tall young man (size before age).
  • ⚠ У неё длинные волосы / Оның шашы ұзын → She HAS long hair — English uses the verb has.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two lines describing a friend: She/He is … / She/He has … .

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

My best friend is called Aida. She's tall and young. She has long black hair and brown eyes. She's very friendly and funny.

Check yourself:

  • Did you use is / are for personality (She's friendly)?
  • Did you use has / have for hair & eyes?
  • Is the adjective order right (a tall young man)?
